330 #===============================================================================
  331 # Restore HP
  332 #===============================================================================
  333 def pbItemRestoreHP(pkmn, restoreHP)
  334   newHP = pkmn.hp + restoreHP
  335   newHP = pkmn.totalhp if newHP > pkmn.totalhp
  336   hpGain = newHP - pkmn.hp
  337   pkmn.hp = newHP
  338   return hpGain
  339 end
  340 
  341 def pbHPItem(pkmn, restoreHP, scene)
  342   if !pkmn.able? || pkmn.hp == pkmn.totalhp
  343     scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It won't have any effect."))
  344     return false
  345   end
  346   pbSEPlay("Use item in party")
  347   hpGain = pbItemRestoreHP(pkmn, restoreHP)
  348   scene.pbRefresh
  349   scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP was restored by {2} points.", pkmn.name, hpGain))
  350   return true
  351 end
  352 
  353 def pbBattleHPItem(pkmn, battler, restoreHP, scene)
  354   if battler
  355     if battler.pbRecoverHP(restoreHP) > 0
  356       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP was restored.", battler.pbThis))
  357     end
  358   elsif pbItemRestoreHP(pkmn, restoreHP) > 0
  359     scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP was restored.", pkmn.name))
  360   end
  361   return true
  362 end
  363 
  364 #===============================================================================
  365 # Restore PP
  366 #===============================================================================
  367 def pbRestorePP(pkmn, idxMove, pp)
  368   return 0 if !pkmn.moves[idxMove] || !pkmn.moves[idxMove].id
  369   return 0 if pkmn.moves[idxMove].total_pp <= 0
  370   oldpp = pkmn.moves[idxMove].pp
  371   newpp = pkmn.moves[idxMove].pp + pp
  372   newpp = pkmn.moves[idxMove].total_pp if newpp > pkmn.moves[idxMove].total_pp
  373   pkmn.moves[idxMove].pp = newpp
  374   return newpp - oldpp
  375 end
